context.purpose: Convert captured ASCII triangle/tetra/hexahedron meshes between VTU and legacy VTK 4.2 with explicit length units, exact ordered topology and preserved scalar/vector point/cell values. Strict subset refuses unsupported data before native mapping.
context.assumptions: Declared source/target length units; positive tetra orientation and nondegenerate triangles; POSIX meshio 5.3.5 isolated Python. Hexahedral Jacobians must exceed the documented relative threshold at 17 samples; sampled positivity is not a global validity proof.
context.constraints: 16MiB source/32MiB output; 100000 points/cells; 16 scalar/vector arrays per association. No compressed/binary/appended/DTD/metadata/solver formats.
context.inspection: Independent stdlib source/output parsers compare transformed coordinates, ordered connectivity and every field tuple; separate native reopening checks consistency. Hexahedral signed volume is integrated using a tensor two-point Gauss rule; all sampled Jacobians also compare at relative 1e-8.
context.recovery: INVALID_MESH_SOURCE needs bounded regular matching path; INVALID_MESH_CONTENT needs supported intact ASCII geometry and positive orientation; inspect native logs for runtime failures.
